description: This file contains OpenAPI/Swagger-like definitions for the DOCSIS WAN Interface API, including request/response schemas, response codes, and event notifications related to DOCSIS WAN interfaces.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Network.WAN.DOCSIS.Get

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Network.WAN.DOCSIS.Set
